subject: Media Literacy
title: Nazi Propaganda Machine
description: A quick, practical guide to Nazi Propaganda Machine.

hook.text: Joseph Goebbels controlled every newspaper, radio station, and film studio in Nazi Germany.

buildup.text: Nazi propaganda blamed Jews for Germany's problems and portrayed Aryans as a superior race.

discovery.text: The Nazis understood that propaganda must be simple, emotional, and endlessly repeated.

twist.text: Goebbels called it the 'Big Lie' — make it enormous and repeat it until people accept it as truth.

climax.text: Nazi propaganda didn't just support the regime. It made the Holocaust psychologically possible.

punchline.text: The Big Lie works because people can't believe anyone would lie that big.

quiz.question: What was the 'Big Lie' technique?
options: Make the lie enormous and repeat it until accepted
